title: Co-op climbing camera (Camera Distance 2.9.13-dev2, DPC 0.9.172-dev22)
intro: Two controllers, both awake. Somewhere with a big climbable monster (cyclops, ogre...), playing the Arisen, co-op off. As long as you like; End (keyboard) ends a step.

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.aim: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.cfg.coop_aim == true
probes.dbg: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.ta_dbg or '')
probes.p2t: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.coop.tgt_name or 'none')
probes.pin: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.pin ~= nil
probes.p1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.p1 ~= nil
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.flicks: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.ta.flick_n or 0) or 0
probes.cam: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.cfg.coop_cam_turn)
probes.camn: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.cct.n or 0) or 0
probes.flips: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.cct.flips or 0) or 0
probes.f1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.ta.f1 and (D.R.ta.f1.flick_n or 0) or 0
probes.yaw: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local y = D and D.R.cam_yaw(); return y and math.floor(math.deg(y) + 0.5)
probes.climb: local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'); local mc = cm and cm:call('getMainCameraController', 0); local ct = mc and mc:call('get_CurrentControlType'); if type(ct) == 'userdata' then ct = ct:get_field('value__') end; return ct

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts (player 1 the Arisen).

Camera turning is now BOTH STICKS (the default). Find a big monster to climb. PLAYER 1 climbs it while PLAYER 2 stays back or moves around. The climbing camera should now pull back to keep player 2 in view. Tune it in the REFramework menu: Camera Distance > suspend options > 'Co-op: climbing camera further back'. Play as long as you like; End when done.
Done. PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op. Tell Claude how the climbing camera looked and which 'further back' value felt right.
